title: Kulgam terrorist attack: Chhattisgarh government declares ₹20 lakh aid for kin of two workers killed
description: Deepak Ratre, a resident of Sakti district, and Bhupendra Bhaina from Sarangarh-Bilaigarh district, both in their 20s, were gunned down at the brick kiln where they were employed in the Kelam area of south Kashmir's Kulgam district late on July 31 evening
